MA:phaseoutPear.says: Prohibited plant in Massachusetts after December 31, 2028: since September 19, 2024 nursery agents and growers may not receive new stock or begin growing it, and they may sell existing stock only through December 31, 2028, "with limited exceptions in orchards" (MDAR Prohibited Plant List, phase-out table)
MA:phaseoutPear.title: Massachusetts Prohibited Plant List (Department of Agricultural Resources) and water chestnut law (M.G.L. c. 128, §20A)
MA:phaseoutPear.edition: Massachusetts Prohibited Plant List as of May 2026, with the Department of Agricultural Resources' additions of December 8, 2025 and May 11, 2026; the list page's statement of what it forbids and its phase-out table, as saved November 1, 2026 (the page printed "Last updated: February 27, 2026", though its table holds the May 11, 2026 additions); General Laws, chapter 128, section 20A, as published by the 194th General Court (no amendment date printed)
